notes: Fair Work Week Ordinance (LAMC Ch. XVIII Art. 5) covers retail businesses (NAICS) with 300+ employees globally; employees who work 2+ hours a week in the City of Los Angeles. Effective April 1, 2023.

Predictability pay: 1 hour for an increase >15 min or a change of date/time/location; 0.5x for hours not worked when hours are cut by 15+ min or an on-call shift is not used (extra key reduced_hours_fraction).
Clopening (<10 h between shifts spanning two workdays) requires written consent and 1.5x pay for the second shift (extra key premium_applies_to='shift').

rules.summary: Large retailers (300+ employees globally) must post schedules 14 days ahead and pay predictability pay for later employer changes.

citation.title: Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards — Fair Work Week Information
citation.excerpt: Provide Employees advance notice of their Work Schedules at least 14 calendar days before the start of a work period

rules.summary: A shift starting less than 10 hours after a closing shift needs the employee's written consent and is paid at 1.5x.

citation.title: Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards — Fair Work Week Information
citation.excerpt: If the second Shift starts less than ten (10) hours after the end of the previous Shift, Employers must pay Employees time and a half

rules.summary: The City of Los Angeles minimum wage is $18.42 an hour from July 1, 2026.

citation.title: Los Angeles Office of Wage Standards — Minimum Wage
